name: reframekit
description: Turn one finished video into the version each place takes: 9:16, 4:5, 1:1 and 16:9, with a crop that follows what moves in each shot, each cut at a shot change to the place's length, kept under its file size limit and set to -14 LUFS.

interface.shortDescription: One video in every shape each place takes
interface.longDescription: Makes the 9:16, 4:5, 1:1 and 16:9 versions of a finished video for TikTok, Reels, Shorts, the feeds, YouTube, X and LinkedIn. In each shot the crop follows what moves, or shows the whole picture on a blurred copy when the action is too wide for it. Each file is cut at a shot change to the place's length, kept under its file size limit and set to -14 LUFS, with a cover. crop.json and sheet.png show every window so it can be moved before rendering. Needs Node 22 or newer and ffmpeg 4.4 or newer in a build made with --enable-gpl, and no API key.
defaultPrompt: Make the TikTok, Reels and square versions of film.mp4
